answer: To secure a decentralized AI agent economy against Sybil attacks, networks can implement a computational proof-of-work protocol modeled as a cryptographic prism. This mechanism refracts verification tasks through a computational trellis, requiring each verified agent to lock verifiable cryptographic stakes in a secure network harbor. The cost to an attacker scales linearly with computational resources and locked capital, making the mass generation of fake autonomous identities economically prohibitive.
